full_judgment: 3. The sole defendant-appellant entered appearance in and contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations of the plaintiff and contending inter alia in brief that, the suit is not maintainable in its present form, the plaintiffs suit is barred by limitation, that the allegations of the plaintiff as to deposit in the bank is false, fraudulent and collusive, that no such deposit was made by the plaintiff. The defendant further staled in his written statement that the plaintiff and the former cashier Md. Sirajul Islam of the bank were closely connected through friendship and the plaintiff managed to have some pay-in-slips through him, these pay-in-slips were fictitious and collusive and the said cashier is a necessary party in the suit, that the suit is not maintainable and is liable to be dismissed.
